why_lead: Kept as lead. It has never led (earlier leads: XRP, zero-day VIX, Rheinmetall twice, Alibaba, IonQ, Robinhood), and it is the best-supported lead today: TSLA closed at 230.58 after -15.24% over five sessions and -34.26% over 20, with more retail headlines in this feed than any other name. The boycott-buy angle ran as the 2025-03-10 smaller trade, but the catalysts changed on 2025-03-11: Trump said he would buy a Tesla and called the boycott illegal, Musk launched an appeal for the $56bn pay package, New York senators urged pension divestment, and Dan Ives's tone changed.
why_smaller: Quantum / IONQ: kept because the story changed.
